mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from AEO for a plumbing company?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline to see results from AEO can vary significantly depending on several factors, including the current state of your website, the competitiveness of your local market, and the consistency of your content creation efforts. Generally, businesses might start to see initial improvements in featured snippet appearances or voice search visibility within 3 to 6 months. However, achieving sustained and impactful results, especially for competitive terms, typically requires ongoing optimization and content updates over 6 to 12 months. AEO is an ongoing strategy, not a one-time fix.
acceptedAnswer.description: Results from AEO can appear within 3-6 months for initial visibility, but sustained impact typically requires 6-12 months of ongoing optimization and content updates.
